{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''herb''' grew in the caves of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], and the [[exoboar]]s native to the planet were actively repelled by the scent of the plant. [[Sarthon Quis]], one of the [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] who were stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|Exoboar}}</ref> when [[Unidentified refugee transport|their transport]] crashed there during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture,<ref name="History">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|The History of Makeb}}</ref> discovered the effect the herb had on exoboars, and used it to his advantage to become a famous exoboar hunter.<ref name="Codex" />

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Makeb herb was mentioned in the Codex entry for exoboars in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
